scope: Gemini Developer API Models and Interactions, with optional legacy generation, counting, embeddings, tools, structured output, vision, and thinking surfaces

probes.name: Models list: HTTP
probes.description: GET /models returns a successful Google JSON response

probes.name: Models list: schema
probes.description: The Google models envelope and names are valid

probes.name: Models list: pagination
probes.description: nextPageToken can retrieve a distinct follow-up page

probes.name: Models list: unique names
probes.description: Model names are unique after normalizing the models/ prefix

probes.name: Google API-key authentication
probes.description: The x-goog-api-key header is accepted

probes.name: Interactions model selection
probes.description: At least one explicitly selected or profile-allowlisted model is eligible for the modern Interactions core

probes.name: Model metadata
probes.description: GET /models/{id} returns metadata for the selected model

probes.name: Model metadata: limits
probes.description: Advertised token limits are non-negative and coherent

probes.name: Model metadata: methods
probes.description: supportedGenerationMethods is a string array when advertised

probes.name: Model metadata: thinking
probes.description: The thinking metadata flag is boolean when advertised

probes.name: Google model parameters
probes.description: Google model-parameter analysis is explicitly reported as not implemented in this release

probes.name: Interactions basic
probes.description: A stateless Interaction returns the requested text

probes.name: Interactions schema
probes.description: Interaction response has id, object, status, steps, and usage

probes.name: Interactions output text
probes.description: Model output text can be extracted without exposing thought content

probes.name: Interactions usage
probes.description: Interaction usage is non-negative and normalized

probes.name: Interactions stateless request
probes.description: Default Interaction requests send store=false

probes.name: Interactions status
probes.description: Interaction status is a recognized terminal state

probes.name: Invalid model error
probes.description: An invalid model produces a structured client error

probes.name: Google error shape
probes.description: Errors use the Google RPC-like error envelope

probes.name: Malformed JSON errors
probes.description: Multiple malformed JSON variants are rejected as client errors

probes.name: Interactions stream: HTTP
probes.description: Interactions streaming returns text/event-stream

probes.name: Interactions stream: syntax
probes.description: Interactions SSE framing and JSON data are valid

probes.name: Interactions stream: event types
probes.description: Known SSE event names match their JSON event type

probes.name: Interactions stream: sequence
probes.description: Interactions SSE lifecycle is legal

probes.name: Interactions stream: text
probes.description: Interactions deltas reconstruct the requested text

probes.name: Interactions stream: completed
probes.description: Interactions stream contains interaction.completed after all steps

probes.name: Interactions stream: usage
probes.description: Interactions stream exposes valid final usage

probes.name: Interactions stream: done
probes.description: Interactions stream ends with completed and [DONE]

probes.name: Interactions tools
probes.description: Client-side function declarations are accepted

probes.name: Interactions structured output
probes.description: Interactions output conforms to a local JSON schema

probes.name: Interactions vision
probes.description: Bounded image input is accepted without retaining media

probes.name: Interactions thinking
probes.description: Thinking request is accepted while raw thoughts remain private

probes.name: Interactions stateful
probes.description: Opt-in stateful Interaction resources are cleaned up

probes.name: Interactions stateful cleanup
probes.description: Every AIQA-created stateful Interaction is deleted or confirmed absent
